title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: modernised Gallery view prioritises video on stage
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, video-prioritised default, licensing and documented management route are supported. The pre-check's missing path words are formatting and placeholder differences, not incorrect navigation; the briefing clearly distinguishes the generic settings route from the unpublished Gallery setting label.
